summary: Iteration 9 verification of SocietyHub report-formatting work (S.No everywhere, DD-MM-YYYY dates, tips payer column, Floor field, sewage-sheet owner statement, new meter-wise Water Usage report, export changes). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_report_formats.py — 20/20 passed against the public preview URL (flat floor create/update/persist, statement rows carrying floor/payment_status/last_paid_on, meter rows carrying flat_number/floor/owner_name/charge, totals.tanker_count + metered_charges consistency, tanker with a DIFFERENT tips payer routing contributions correctly, MIS CSV headers/serials/Total Expense+Exp per head/water-usage section/no ISO dates, MIS PDF text extraction, annual CSV+PDF S.No, rentals CSV/PDF S.No + Previous dues, rent receipt PDF DD-MM-YYYY + readable Mode + Reference row). Frontend (Playwright, public URL, admin login + Maintenance workspace): MIS owner table (S.No first, Floor col, mis-footer 'Total Expense · split between 4 houses ... Exp per head'), Water usage report card with all 10 columns, footer and full legend, combined column verified with a 2-meter flat (rowSpan grouping correct, Combined = 943.93 = 927.44+16.49); Reconciliation owner statement (S.No, House/Flat, Floor, 'Owner (Tenant — tenant)', Amount, Paid/Partial/Pending chip, Payment date DD-MM-YYYY, footer) and a recorded payment flipped flat 202 Pending -> Partial with date 21-08-2026; Water tanker table (S.No, DD-MM-YYYY dates, separate 'Lorry paid by' / 'Tips paid by' columns, footer with Exp per head) and a UI-created tanker with lorry payer 101 + tips payer 201 rendered both columns correctly; Meter readings S.No; Charges Recurring + One-time tabs (S.No, Date DD-MM-YYYY, recurring-footer/adhoc-footer with Total Expense + Exp per head); Setup > Flats floor dropdown on add form + inline per-row editor (set 201 to Third, persisted after reload and propagated to MIS/Reconcile/Water-usage); MIS CSV and PDF download from the UI; rentals regression (Units, Collections, Deposits, Payouts building table, Property Reports all have S.No and DD-MM-YYYY dates, no ISO dates anywhere, Bills page carry-forward 'Previous dues' intact). Zero console errors on every page visited (Dashboard, Overview, Annual, MIS, Reconcile, Water, Charges, Setup, all rentals pages).

minor.issue: PaymentIn.direction is a free-form str (default 'received'). Posting direction='receipt' is accepted; the engine treats anything != 'payout' as money received, but the Reconcile ledger badge renders it as 'Payout' — silently mislabeled data. Use Literal['received','payout'].
STILL OPEN from iteration 8: prev_outstanding() fallback invents carry_forward (10500) for months before a unit existed when the unit has no lease_start.

Water-usage section omits the per-flat 'Combined' column that the UI shows for flats with 2+ meters, so a multi-meter flat's combined charge is not visible in the export (parity gap with the on-screen report).
Body field is 'readings'; no request-shape docs/testids issue, just noting for future test authors (sending 'rows' returns 422).

issues: A flat whose net is <= 0 only because it fronted expenses (e.g. 101, 201) shows chip 'Paid' with Payment date '—' even though nothing was received. Matches engine intent (settled) but on the user's Paid/Pending sheet it can read as 'money received'. Confirm the wording with the user (e.g. 'Settled' vs 'Paid').

design_issues.screen: Water / Charges / Reconciliation forms + rentals month picker
issues: Native browser date/month inputs (input type=date / type=month) are used instead of the shadcn calendar component (pre-existing, not introduced this round).
In a rowSpan group the S.No/House/Floor/Owner cells are top-aligned while the Combined cell renders vertically centered, so the grouped row looks slightly unbalanced. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: constrain PaymentIn.direction to a Literal so 'receipt'-style values cannot be stored and mislabeled as Payout in the ledger.
Optional: add the per-flat Combined water charge to the MIS CSV/PDF water-usage section for parity with the UI.
Still open from iteration 8: guard prev_outstanding() on lease_start/created_at so units without lease dates do not show bogus previous dues.
Confirm wording of the 'Paid' chip for flats that are settled only via fronted expenses (no payment received, no payment date).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 1137 lines and rentals.py 785 — the MIS CSV/PDF builders (~200 lines) should move into a reports module.
engine.compute_statement payment_status derives 'paid' from net <= 0.005 while last_paid_on stays empty; consider a distinct 'settled' state so the report's Paid/Pending column is unambiguous.

Legacy suites (test_iter6_rentals_rebuild.py, test_media_notify.py, backend_test.py::TestTipsInWaterCost, test_iter7 draft test) assert absolute amounts against the shared preview DB and now fail purely because of accumulated TEST_ records and this round's seed data — 15 failures total, all data-dependent, not code regressions. They need per-test fixtures/cleanup or relative assertions.
seed_data_creation: Sunrise Residency (2026-08): floors set (101/102 Ground, 201 Third after UI test, 202 First), 2 tankers with tips payer != lorry payer, 1 recurring charge (Maid, 2000) + 1 one-time charge (Motor repair, 3000), one 1000 payment for flat 202 (2026-08-21). A temporary second meter 'Meter 101-B' on flat 101 and a stray direction='receipt' payment were created to verify the Combined column and then DELETED. Meter readings already existed in the demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container clock is Aug 2026, so the frontend default period is 2026-08 — use the LAST entry of /api/periods (not the first, which is the empty 2026-07) when asserting on data. Rentals export endpoint is GET /api/rentals/export?month=&format=; MIS/annual exports use ?format= (not fmt) and annual also needs ?year=. PUT /api/readings expects body key 'readings'. Iteration-9 report-format work (S.No, DD-MM-YYYY, tips payer, Floor, owner statement, water usage report, exports) is fully verified — no need to re-test in depth. Legacy suites iter6/iter7/media_notify/backend_test have data-dependent failures against the shared preview DB.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in this round's scope. The only new observation with user impact is the semantic overlap of the 'Paid' chip with settled-by-fronting flats, and the missing Combined column in the exported water-usage section.
